decisionBasis: Direct visual inspection of exactly the seven target.image.path comparison images, once each through view_image, in one seven-image batch. Each composite contains zh/en at desktop 1440x960 and mobile 390x844. Input metadata identifies the panels; DOM evidence and input PASS flags are not visual proof.
approvalBoundary: PASS applies only to visible first-choice stems, options, labels and mathematical typography in these seven hash-bound composites. It does not approve a complete card, uncaptured content, runtime behavior, semantic correctness or publication.

semanticReview.priorStatus: User-reported PASS for 7 sources, 14 bilingual questions and 44 options; not reopened or independently revalidated here.

The stem's final variable and question mark wrap onto their own line without disappearing. A-C follow below; C's lowest denominator and exponent remain inside the image, and the radical and fraction strokes are intact.

limitations: Existing comparison pixels are the only visual evidence; no screenshots were captured, rerendered or reopened.
Completeness refers to the visible stem/option text and terminal lines in these composites, not a renewed comparison against authored content or source mathematics.
No separate panels, full screenshots, old images, lesson surfaces or answer surfaces were opened.
No test, environment, network, database, paid, Git, code or canonical-content operations were performed.
Only report.json and usage.json were authored inside the assigned output directory; unrelated worktree edits were left untouched.
Return is text-only so no image payload is sent to the parent context.
